sql:
with test_bytes as (
  select
    inbytes,
    description,
    (test_conv(inbytes || repeat('.', 3)::bytea, 'utf8', 'utf8')).error
  from utf8_verification_inputs
), test_padded as (
  select
    description,
    (test_conv(inbytes || repeat('.', 64)::bytea, 'utf8', 'utf8')).error
  from test_bytes
)
select
  description,
  b.error as orig_error,
  p.error as error_after_padding
from test_padded p
join test_bytes b
using (description)
where p.error is distinct from b.error
order by description
shape: WITH test_bytes AS (SELECT inbytes, description, (test_conv(inbytes || repeat('.', 3)::bytea, 'utf8', 'utf8')).error FROM utf8_verification_inputs), test_padded AS (SELECT description, (test_conv(inbytes || repeat('.', 64)::bytea, 'utf8', 'utf8')).error FROM test_bytes) SELECT description, b.error AS orig_error, p.error AS error_after_padding FROM test_padded AS p JOIN test_bytes AS b USING (description) WHERE p.error IS DISTINCT FROM b.error ORDER BY description;

  p.error as error_after_padding

where p.error is distinct from b.error
order by description
